about_short_description.short_description: Infinite Machine is to create the world's most captivating non-auto vehicles.

product.name: P1
product.description: A two-passenger electric motorcycle for city and car-lane travel, with a 6 kW motor, 65 mph top speed, and approximately 60 miles of real-world urban range.

product.name: Olto
product.description: A two-passenger Class 2 electric vehicle designed for bike lanes, offering pedal assist and throttle operation, a 20 mph top speed, and approximately 35 miles of range.

product.name: Fleet Deployment
product.description: A commercial vehicle program for deploying Infinite Machine vehicles across hospitality, last-mile delivery, law enforcement, and shared-campus operations.

product.name: Dealer Program
product.description: A partner program for authorized dealers to sell and support P1 and Olto vehicles, with wholesale pricing, marketing resources, training, warranty support, and dedicated account management.

product.name: Vehicle Service and Warranty Support
product.description: Post-sale support for Infinite Machine vehicles, including limited warranty coverage, nationwide service partners, mobile repairs, self-service guides, spare parts, and software updates.

product.name: Test Ride Experience
product.description: Scheduled and walk-in demonstrations of Infinite Machine vehicles at company showrooms and pop-up locations, allowing prospective customers to ride and evaluate P1 and Olto.
